sequence.target: original checkpoint outputs plus that region's shift
sequence.retention: current checkpoint outputs on the other two public regions
sequence.selection: none; all three edits and both methods fixed before any heldout evaluation

bootstrap.unit: independent world; average paired family effects within each world
bootstrap.incomplete_world_policy: omit worlds missing any main arm or family; retain available main outcomes descriptively; ablation failures do not remove main outcomes

accounting.proposer: deterministic algorithm; no language model, API calls, or provider tokens
allowed: validation feedback for six fixed candidates
accounting.heldout: one post-seal evaluator callback for all predeclared arms; actual model-example executions reported separately
accounting.limits: metadata and every returned candidate reveal full captured weights; those scalar values are charged
accounting.training: random frozen feature extractors; only output heads fitted by ridge on the training split
accounting.split_lineage: independent random streams within world; family checkpoints share teacher and input splits; no claim that families are independent tasks

primary_descriptive_contrasts: matched random minus soft target NRMSE
controls: fixed-iteration gradient on the same soft objective
not_established: LLM programming ability or replication of the report
no-fitting or no-data parity with the source Go protocol
behavior in the unmeasured main-region gap
formal verification of Python or optimizer
